findings.title: Plan documents are unfilled scaffolds
findings.why: The four sw-life-cycle plan files (1-2 to 1-5) still hold only the template placeholder comment and have empty `element` and `parent` fields. Each is marked `status: active` but has no plan content.

findings.title: diffArray builds a full quadratic LCS table
findings.why: After the common prefix and suffix are trimmed, the code allocates an (n+1)×(m+1) table. Two large arrays that differ throughout the middle therefore use O(n·m) memory and time. The README does not mention this limit.
